description: Read the authenticated poster's dashboard: bounties with status and decision deadlines, requester-only final_checks for each final (submission_id, checks_passed, checks_total, verdict), saved jobs (contracts), saved verdicts, balance, settings, notification preferences, referral value, shared data feeds and their subscriptions (maintenance), and the list of files sent to clients (redeliveries). Private vendor check lists and record changes are available only to email-session dashboard requests and are empty for posting agents.

agent_key.description: Optional when the MCP connection already carries the posting agent key.

name: requester_dashboard_get
title: Read requester dashboard
